propositions.name: Limit
propositions.statement: A limit is the value a function approaches as its input approaches a point.

propositions.name: One-sided limit
propositions.statement: A one-sided limit approaches a point from only the left or only the right.

propositions.name: Continuity
propositions.statement: A function is continuous at a point when its limit there equals its value.

propositions.name: Force
propositions.statement: A net force on an object equals its mass times its acceleration.

propositions.name: Momentum
propositions.statement: Momentum is the product of an object’s mass and its velocity.

propositions.name: Impulse
propositions.statement: The impulse on an object equals its change in momentum.
